newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Australia shares dip with profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Australia shares dip with profit.

text.p: Shares in chemical manufacturer ICI Australia Ltd slipped 30 cents to an intraday low of A$12.30, albeit on thin trade, after its lower full year profit, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the company reported 26.7 percent lower net profit of A$197.1 million for the 12 months to September 30.

While the profit result was the only news, brokers noted the tightly held nature of the high priced stock, owned 62.4 percent by Imperial Chemical Industries ltd, saying its illiquidity meant price movements were likely to be exaggerated.
"It's a reaction to the result, that's all," said broker Tony Russell of Morgan Stockbroking.
"Plus it's a A$12 dollar stock so dropping 25 cents is not that much."
Other agreed, adding that ICI trade had not been particularly active.
"The profit (result) has pushed it down but there is not that much activity in the stock," said a Sydney dealer.
By 1.00 p.m. (0200 GMT), ICI Australia shares were 20 cents lower at A$12.40 on turnover of 67,639 shares.
